      • withTLS

        public ApiWrapperBuilder withTLS(java.io.File certFile)
        Enable TLS with custom certificate

        Recommend using TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 for better security. For generating self-signed certificates, tools like OpenSSL can be used (e.g., OpenSSL Req).

        Parameters:
        certFile - The certificate file

      • withTLS

        public ApiWrapperBuilder withTLS()
        Enable TLS using the system trust certificates.

        A certificate previously set by withTLS(File) is cleared.

      • addInterceptors

        public ApiWrapperBuilder addInterceptors(java.util.List<io.grpc.ClientInterceptor> interceptors)
        Add multiple custom interceptors. Null elements are ignored.

        Custom interceptors are applied outside the timeout interceptor, so they cannot change the deadline set by withTimeout(long).
